scope: Full MD5 article only: RFC 1321's definition, the MD4-to-MD5 strengthening, the cryptanalytic history from den Boer-Bosselaers 1993 through Wang-Yu 2005 and Stevens' certificate forgeries, the RFC 6151 guidance, and the NTLM v2 HMAC-MD5 deployment. No completion claim for SHA-1, SHA-2, SHA-3, RIPEMD, HAVAL, MD2, HMAC as a standalone entity, modes of operation, protocols, key management, implementations or the whole library.

coverageRationale.zh: 专门解释 RFC 1321 定义的 MD5：512 位块、128 位摘要、填充与 64 位长度、IV、F/G/H/I 四个按位函数、四轮 64 次操作、正弦轮常量、旋转后回加与小端输出；覆盖 MD4 到 MD5 的六处加强、OID 与 CMS/PKCS #1 中的标识、NTLM v2 的 HMAC-MD5 用法，以及从 den Boer-Bosselaers、Dobbertin、王小云与余洪波到 Stevens 的破译时间线和 RFC 6151 的用途指引。不把 MD4、SHA 系列、RIPEMD、HAVAL、MD2、HMAC 本身或整个哈希家族并入本实体。
coverageRationale.en: Covers RFC 1321's MD5: 512-bit blocks, 128-bit digest, padding and the 64-bit length, the IV, the F/G/H/I bitwise functions, four rounds of 64 operations, the sine-derived round constants, the post-rotation add-back and little-endian output; the six MD4-to-MD5 strengthenings, the OID and its CMS/PKCS #1 identifiers, the NTLM v2 HMAC-MD5 deployment, the break-in timeline from den Boer-Bosselaers, Dobbertin and Wang-Yu through Stevens, and the RFC 6151 usage guidance. It does not absorb MD4, the SHA series, RIPEMD, HAVAL, MD2, HMAC itself or the whole hash family.

title.zh: MD5：RFC 1321 的 128 位消息摘要与其被逐步攻破的历程
title.en: MD5: the RFC 1321 128-bit message digest and the step-by-step collapse of its collision resistance

entry.relatedPolicy: These are distinct catalog entities. They are linked for context only and are not aliases, merged identities or completed by this article. MD4 is the weaker predecessor whose six differences RFC 1321 section 5 enumerates; HMAC is the construction whose MD5 instantiation RFC 6151 discusses separately; Merkle-Damgard is the shared iteration skeleton; the 2004 collision event is the public announcement point of the Wang et al. result. The catalog also holds duplicate sha-1/sha1, sha-2/sha2 and sha-3/sha3 pairs and an ambiguous alias between the Wang Xiaoyun person record and the 2004 collision event that require separate identity review and are deliberately not linked here.
